periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented inward toward the muzzle at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial plane.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly elongated oval with the vertical-oblique length significantly exceeding the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Marked downward tapering where the lower margin of the patch extends well below the geometric center toward the maxillary region.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band occupies approximately 45% of the visible dorsal-ventral height of the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral placement with an inter-ear gap estimated at twice the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Generally semicircular with slight flattening observed at the superior-most apex of the ear contour.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized pinkish area of potential fur thinning or minor abrasion is visible on the sagittal midline of the cranial vault.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly prominent and elongated white vibrissae extending from the lateral aspects of the snout.
